start: Sign in screen, the WhatsApp way is on, the owner has forgotten the PIN and is still signed in on another phone

steps.action: Open the forgot-PIN card from Sign in
user_sees: Card titled 'Forgot your PIN?'
Button 'Can’t use WhatsApp? Other ways back in'
must_not: The other ways hidden behind the WhatsApp check with no way to reach them

steps.action: Tap 'Can’t use WhatsApp? Other ways back in'
user_sees: Box titled 'Other ways back in'
Line starting '1. Signed in on another phone, computer or browser? There, open Staff & sign-in'
Line '2. Another owner of your gym can make a code for you the same way. Front desk staff: ask your gym owner for a code.'
Line starting '3. Not signed in anywhere? Email contact@mettleup.fit'
'After you sign in with a code, you can choose a new PIN straight away.'
must_not: A line cut off or missing
The email shown as plain text that cannot be tapped

steps.action: On the other signed-in phone open Staff & sign-in and tap 'Make sign-in code' next to the own name
user_sees: Sheet 'Your sign-in code' with a 6-digit code
must_not: No code button on the owner’s own row

steps.action: Back on the first device type the mobile number and that code in the PIN box, sign in
user_sees: The gym opens
An offer to choose a new PIN at once
must_not: The old PIN asked for before a new one can be set
The code refused because it was typed in the PIN box

start: Sign in screen while the WhatsApp way is switched off (or its status check got no answer)

steps.action: Open the forgot-PIN card from Sign in
user_sees: Card titled 'Forgot your PIN?'
Box 'Other ways back in' open already, with the three numbered lines
Button 'Back to sign in'
must_not: A WhatsApp button that cannot work
An empty card

steps.action: Tap 'Back to sign in'
user_sees: The Sign in form again
must_not: The typed mobile number lost

start: Sign in screen; the only owner, signed in nowhere, no WhatsApp

steps.action: Open 'Other ways back in' and read lines 1 and 2
user_sees: Lines 1 and 2 do not fit: no other device, no other owner
must_not: Words that promise a code without any check of who is asking

steps.action: Tap contact@mettleup.fit in line 3
user_sees: The mail app opens with contact@mettleup.fit as the receiver
Line 3 says 'We call you to check it is you, then give you a sign-in code.'
must_not: A link that does nothing
A box to type the gym name here that sends nothing

start: Forgot-PIN card with the WhatsApp way on, 'Other ways back in' closed

steps.action: Tap 'Can’t use WhatsApp? Other ways back in', then tap it again
user_sees: The box opens, then closes
must_not: Two boxes shown
The mobile number typed above wiped

steps.action: Tap 'Verify with WhatsApp' and look at the button while the check starts
user_sees: The 'Other ways back in' button is greyed while the card says 'Please wait…'
must_not: The box opening on top of the waiting step

steps.action: After the number is checked, look at the card
user_sees: 'Number checked' and the new PIN boxes; the other-ways button is gone
must_not: The other ways still offered after the number is already checked

start: Sign in screen on a shared computer, nobody signed in

steps.action: Open 'Other ways back in' without typing any number
user_sees: The same fixed words for everyone
must_not: Any gym name, person name or mobile number shown
A hint whether a number has an account

steps.action: Read line 3
user_sees: 'We call you to check it is you, then give you a sign-in code.'
must_not: A code given by email alone, with no call

start: Sign in screen, a front desk person has forgotten the PIN

steps.action: Open the forgot-PIN card and tap 'Can’t use WhatsApp? Other ways back in'
user_sees: Line 2 ends 'Front desk staff: ask your gym owner for a code.'
must_not: Words that tell staff to email MettleUp first

steps.action: Ask the owner; the owner makes a code for this person
user_sees: The owner reads out a 6-digit code
must_not: A code that works for another person’s number

steps.action: Type the own mobile number and the code in the PIN box, sign in
user_sees: The gym opens with front desk rights
An offer to choose a new PIN
must_not: Owner rights given
The old PIN asked for

start: Sign in screen while the WhatsApp way is switched off

steps.action: Open the forgot-PIN card
user_sees: Card 'Forgot your PIN?' with the 'Other ways back in' box open and 'Back to sign in'
must_not: An empty card
The older one-line words only

start: A front desk person still signed in on a second phone follows line 1

steps.action: On the second phone open Staff & sign-in
user_sees: Card 'You' with the own name
'Only an owner can add people or make sign-in codes. Ask your gym owner.'
must_not: A 'Make sign-in code' button for staff
A list of the other people

steps.action: Go back to the first device
user_sees: Still not signed in; line 2 is the way that works
must_not: The person left with no next step named

start: Forgot-PIN card, a mobile number already typed on Sign in

steps.action: Open the other-ways box, close it, tap 'Back to sign in'
user_sees: The Sign in form
must_not: The typed number lost
The forgot card still open under the form
